svg.title: Azores Current: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 3600 km. OSW reference corridor from a Grand Banks branch-region gate near 40 N / 45 W, southeast to the Mid-Atlantic Ridge near 34 N / 37 W, then eastward toward an offshore Gulf of Cadiz approach gate. Excludes upstream Gulf Stream, North Atlantic branch, Azores Countercurrent, southern recirculation, southward branches into the North Equatorial/Canary routes and Gibraltar/Mediterranean inflow. No whole connected-system length. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate Azores eastward corridor — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 81 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: Frazao et al. (2022), introduction; OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
